title: Number of Distinct Averages
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums of even length, repeatedly remove the minimum and maximum numbers, calculate their average, and continue this process until the array is empty.
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums of even length, repeatedly remove the minimum and maximum numbers, calculate their average, and continue this process until the array is empty. Return the total number of distinct averages obtained through this process.
constraints: Repeatedly remove its current minimum and maximum and record their average.
Return the number of distinct recorded averages.
hints: Sort the values so current minima and maxima are at opposite ends.
Store each pair sum; two averages are equal exactly when their sums are equal because every pair is divided by two.
Sorted symmetric pairs are exactly the sequence of extreme removals, and the set counts distinct results.
editorial: Sorted symmetric pairs are exactly the sequence of extreme removals, and the set counts distinct results.

tests.explanation: Sorted extreme pairs sum to five, five, and seven, producing two distinct averages.
Only one pair is removed, so exactly one average occurs.
